summary:
We received your package today, and tried to phone you tonight but the S.F. info operator said that while your phone did exist, you did not. Preferring not to get into heavy philosophical discussions with phone operators on the nature of reality I agreed that I had made both ofyou up, and planned to continue making up nonexistent peo­ ple and bothering her until she admitted secretly funding the Nixon re-election cam­ paign committee out of her lunch money. 

Anyhow, the toy for Christopher is lovely, and both Tessa and I found hours of amusement in playing with it. As to the book WHOLE GRAINS I must say that it is the finest of its kind (it’s the only one of its kind, 1 take it). But seriously, as we say down here in tinsel town, its a fine book and I found two quotes in it by me, ignoring all the others as items merely to pad it out, so to 
speak. Why was it printed in England or distributed from there or something? Thank you for sending it, and thank you for the dedication. The porno material we fed to the cat, Fred. Sorry about that, but in Fullerton you do that or die. Do I make local laws? Does anybody? 

How are you two and when do you leave for Europe? I think I’m in love with Michele, because every time I meet a girl named Michele my heart beat changes radically, even if she has eight legs and a tail with a stinger on it. Your Michele is the only really good true lovely one, and only a cad wouldn’t make it a legal marriage. A cad or a nitwit, whichever comes first. 
...
